name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-07-01, at wavelengths from 1.07 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
